correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the permitted-exponent condition a=0 or a>=2 and exact prime-power lower/upper envelopes F_p=s(p^3)<=s(p^a)<=s(p^2). Derived the Euler product prod F_p=zeta(4)/(zeta(2)zeta(8))=630/pi^6 and p>=5 tail product L=612360/(697pi^6). The published proof supplies exact rational finite-prime inequalities for p=5,...,23 and for p>=25 uses Nagura's prime-between-x-and-6x/5 theorem to ensure -log F_p<=sum later -log F_q; greedy subsums and exponentiation yield full [L,1] for cube-supported tail products, not just sample density. Splitting supports at p=2,3 and comparing all exponent2/3 endpoints gives the 4 overlapping bands, of which two merge, leaving exactly three with strict gaps. Independently checked Euler product constants, p2/p3 factors, exact pi-bound endpoint inequalities and all four support bands using rational arithmetic; finite verification is supplementary and does not replace Nagura plus the infinite subsum argument.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks corroborate, but where the statement is infinite only the reconstructed analytic argument justifies the universal quantifier.

originality.rationale: Defant introduced s_-r and determined unrestricted density criteria; a directly relevant published result computes exactly two components on all N for r=2. The squarefull condition deletes every exponent-one contribution and changes the permissible prime-tail factors and gap pattern. The known two-component result therefore does not determine the restricted three-component closure, and the additional prime-cube tail/gap proof is substantive.

value.rationale: Connected components of multiplicative-function ranges are an explicit question raised in Defant's work. Restricting to the natural squarefull (powerful) domain is mathematically motivated; the result identifies a genuine topology change from two unrestricted components to three restricted components with all endpoints and no hidden gaps. It does not claim a general r-dependent classification.
residual_risks: Significance is confined to the precise object/invariant and exact scope stated, not a general theory beyond it.

final_claim: For the alternating multiplicative divisor function s_-2(p^a)=sum_{j=0}^a(-p^-2)^j on squarefull integers (including 1), the closure of its range is exactly [630/pi^6,13/16] union [13440/(17pi^6),73/81] union [612360/(697pi^6),1], with exactly three disjoint components.
